title: Push notifications on this device
description: Get a notification on this phone or computer for new work orders, urgent faults and other alerts, even when Liftelo is closed.

state.iosInstall: Needs the app on the home screen

hint.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser or phone settings (site settings > notifications), then come back here.
hint.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
hint.ios: On iPhone and iPad push notifications only work when Liftelo is added to the home screen (Share > Add to Home Screen, iOS 16.4 or newer). Open the app from the home screen and enable them here.
hint.update: If notifications do not arrive, close and reopen the app once so it can update.
hint.perDevice: This setting applies to this device only. Turn it on for each device where you want alerts.

toast.testNone: No device received the test notification.
